commands.summary: Fetched pinned trees for all 10 apps
Read Dockerfiles, compose files, entrypoints, manifests at the pinned commits
OK: expectedFactsSchema parse, id/repo/commit match slice, all facts cited, all cited paths exist in pinned trees

notes: Labels come from repository source only; no Deployz analysis or results were used.
postgres and redis are true only when the default or required configuration uses them (driver plus compose/Dockerfile/config evidence).
migration is set only when a migration command exists in an entrypoint, release script or compose command (repo-587, repo-589).
worker is true only when a separate worker start command is declared (repo-589). Optional worker modes (repo-584 QUEUE_MODE) are false.

unsupported uses local-filesystem for SQLite/data-directory/local content state, mongodb, other-database (ClickHouse). MySQL is not listed as unsupported because docs/product/mvp-scope.md lists RDS MySQL 8.0 as supported; repo-583 and repo-588 are NOT_COMPATIBLE for local-filesystem state.
repo-581 is family deno, but its Dockerfile runs node node.ts, so runtime is node and compatibility READY.
healthPath and port are set only when the source declares them; repo-584 health (/livez) is on a separate port 52346, so no healthPath is given.
Judgement calls to review in verification: repo-583 Ghost and repo-589 OpenProject default to local content/attachment storage (S3 storage is configurable); repo-588 Mautic local config/media.
